questions.question: A writer who has hope in the LORD says we are not consumed because of what?

answers.text: The loving devotion of the LORD
The strength of the city walls

questions.question: In a poem about hope, what does the writer's soul call the LORD?
What reason does a writer give for hope while his people suffer under the Lord's hand?

answers.text: The Lord will not cast us off forever
The Lord will punish our enemies soon
The Lord will rebuild the city walls

questions.question: A writer says the Lord willingly afflicts and grieves the sons of men. True or false?
